prompt: With scanbot1, drive to aisle_1, count the items on shelf_1 with tag_scan1 and, if there are none, carry carton_1 from the backroom to aisle_1.
why: Infeasible in 2.2: the reading is possible (tag_scan1 measures `count` on scanbot1) but the request also needs a `grasp`, and scanbot1 has no gripper. A model must not drop the carry. Under 2.1 the attempt fails earlier, with E217.
